raw_text: Could the app support login with Microsoft accounts too? Half our company is on Microsoft 365.
The PRD editor feels clean and focused. Honestly nicer than the doc tool we used before.
On my 13 inch laptop the roadmap view cuts off the right column and there is no horizontal scroll. I literally can't see the status of the Q4 items.
Password reset email arrives but the link seems to expire very quickly, maybe a few minutes.
Great product overall! A public API so we could push our own survey data in would be amazing.
invited my colleague and the link says invalid when she clicks it. had to resend like 3 times
Please add role based permissions. Right now everyone in the workspace can delete PRDs.
Modal windows don't close when I press escape and the close icon is tiny on mobile. Had to refresh the page to get out of one.
Can admins see a log of who logged in and when? Our security team asked about it.
Export is limited to PDF. We need Word or Markdown, nobody on my team edits PDFs.
Tables don't remember my column widths. I resize them every single time I open the feedback list.
I can't figure out where the PRD export button went after the last update. Spent five minutes clicking around the toolbar.
Super helpful tool. A comparison view between two PRD versions would be the cherry on top.
Dashboard charts never finish loading on our VPN connection. Everyone in the Berlin office has the same problem.
Login is smooth and the remember me option works properly across devices.
The main dashboard takes around 20 seconds to load once we cross a few thousand feedback items. It was fine a month ago.
The AI generated stories are a lot more accurate after the update, haven't hit any weird output this week.
Sentiment shows negative for clearly positive comments. I checked a few and the AI got them wrong.
Switched from Chrome to Safari and had to log in again even though I ticked stay signed in.
Really like how the sentiment colours are consistent across the dashboard and the feedback list. Easy to scan.
Our whole team is stuck. Importing a 5k row CSV froze the app and now every page in the workspace times out.
The layout is fine overall, but the tag filters take up a lot of room on a laptop screen. Maybe make them collapsible?
Really happy with it. Adding GitHub issue links to roadmap items would be a nice bonus.
Locked out of my account after too many attempts and there's no clear way to unlock it myself.
Haven't run into any bugs in a month of daily use. Rock solid for us so far.
Love the new theme board. Seeing feedback clusters as cards makes it so much easier to explain pain points to my team.
Notification bell opens instantly now, nice improvement over last month.
Navigation is mostly intuitive. I only got lost looking for workspace settings, they're hidden under the profile menu.
The sidebar keeps collapsing every time I switch workspaces. I have to reopen it again and again, super annoying.
The automated user story generator sometimes returns the same story twice with different titles.
Really enjoying the tool. Custom fields on feedback items, like account tier and region, would make it perfect for us.
Uploading a CSV with more than 10 columns fails silently, no error, nothing imported.
The AI summary of a theme came back in a couple of seconds. That's impressive compared to other tools we tried.
Filtering feedback by sentiment is super snappy even with a huge list. Good job.
Drag and drop on the roadmap board is jumpy. Cards snap back to their old column about half the time.
Love the automated user stories. It would be perfect if I could set a template for the acceptance criteria format.
Logging in drops me straight into the workspace I used last, which is exactly what I want.
We'd like to enforce 2FA for all members of our workspace. I only see it as optional per user.
Great product so far. Only thing I'd add is a Notion export so we can share PRDs with the wider company.
Cannot bulk export feedback to CSV with the theme tags included, and I need that for our monthly report.
Reported a bug with the CSV import last week and it was fixed in two days. Impressive turnaround.
The latest release fixed the duplicate notifications. Thanks for sorting that out so quickly.
Comments on PRDs sometimes post twice if I click the button quickly.
Imported feedback shows up with weird characters, the apostrophes turn into question marks. Not sure if it's our file.
Dashboard loads noticeably faster since the last release. Used to wait a while, now it's basically instant.
Switching between workspaces takes ages, the spinner just hangs for a while.
Tooltip on the priority score is showing the wrong formula description I think.
Nobody on our team of 25 can sign in since this morning, the login page just spins and returns an error.
We can't adopt this across the company without an SSO integration with Okta, procurement told us this is a blocker.
The empty states are confusing, I thought my import had failed but it was just still processing with no loading indicator.
Theme clustering ran in seconds on our 800 records, much quicker than I expected.
The session expired message shows up, but the page doesn't redirect to login. Minor, but worth fixing.
The roadmap timeline view is really easy on the eyes, our execs actually understood it without me explaining.
Speed is fine overall. The only slow part is the sync with the shared drive, but that might be on our side.
The roadmap is awesome. Adding a quarter view with swimlanes by team would make it complete.
Appreciate that you support magic link login. Really handy for our contractors.
Single sign on worked on the first try with Okta. Smooth experience, thanks!
We really need a two way Jira integration so approved stories show up in our sprint backlog automatically.
The new filter bar is great, saved me a lot of time when prepping for the sprint review.
The 2FA code from the authenticator app is often rejected the first time and works on the second try.
Our dashboard times out whenever we filter by a date range longer than 90 days. We need that for quarterly reviews.
SSO setup with Google Workspace took five minutes, no support needed. Nice.
Imports are way faster after the update. 2k rows done before I finished my coffee.
Would love scheduled weekly digests of new feedback themes sent by email.
Dark mode text on the dashboard cards is too faint, the grey on dark blue is hard to read.
Not sure if it's a bug but the count on the dashboard says 120 feedback items while the list shows 118.
Seeing a small console error on the theme page, nothing seems broken but wanted to flag it.
I keep getting logged out every 10 minutes. Lost my unsaved PRD draft twice this week.
We lost a whole afternoon of edits on our roadmap, the page refreshed and everything reverted to the last version from Monday.
still no slack integration lol. we all live in slack so i copy paste summaries over every week, kinda painful
Got an unexpected error banner once when generating a roadmap, tried again and it worked.
Could we get a mobile app or at least a better mobile layout for reviewing PRDs on the go?
Typing in the PRD editor has a slight delay on long documents. Not a big deal but I noticed it.
Generating a PRD takes almost two minutes. By the time it finishes I've lost my train of thought.
Bulk tagging 200 items works but it takes a while. Could it run in the background?
No way to link feedback to a Linear issue. We track engineering work there so this is a big gap for us.
Onboarding checklist was really clear. I had my first feedback import done within ten minutes without reading any docs.
Would be nice to have keyboard shortcuts for common actions like new PRD or switch workspace.
Searching the feedback list lags badly. I type a keyword and nothing happens for a good five seconds.
Deleting a theme doesn't remove it from the filter dropdown until I refresh.
Would be great to attach screenshots or recordings to a feedback item.
The Jira link keeps failing with 'Something went wrong' and there's no detail about what happened.
Page loads are acceptable for us right now, but I worry about how it will scale when we add the support team's data.
I'd like longer sessions for our internal kiosk dashboard, being logged out every few hours is a pain.
Role assignment on invite is easy to understand, I was able to onboard the whole team in an afternoon.
Not sure if this is intended, but the date pickers use US format and our team works with day first dates.
first load every morning is sooo slow, then it's fine after that. caching maybe??
The password rules aren't shown until after you submit. Would be better to list them up front.
Clicking save on a PRD shows a success toast but when I reopen it my changes are gone.
Pagination on the feedback list goes back to page 1 when I return from an item. Minor annoyance.
It would help if the priority labels used different colours. Right now high and medium look almost the same to me.
SAML login fails with a vague error for half of our users. Others from the same company can sign in fine.
Spotted a typo in the roadmap empty state, it says 'No items yets'. Cosmetic only.
A Confluence integration would make our documentation process much easier.
Error 500 whenever I try to export a PRD that contains a table. Plain text PRDs export fine.
The roadmap page gets really sluggish when there are more than 40 items, scrolling stutters.
Can the AI suggest priority scores based on how many customers mentioned something? That would save a lot of manual work.
Too many clicks to get from a theme to the raw feedback behind it. It would be nice to see quotes right on the theme page.
Exporting to PDF is slow for long PRDs. Not a blocker but I wish there was a progress bar so I know it's working.
It would be really useful to merge duplicate themes. Right now we have three themes that are basically the same thing.
